# Statements and declarations

## Ethical considerations

Ethical approval was not required. The studies reported are computer
simulations. The one empirical dataset used, the `phq9` responses distributed
with the `easyRasch2` R package, is publicly available and fully anonymized.

## Consent to participate

Not applicable.

## Consent for publication

Not applicable.

## Declaration of conflicting interests

The author declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the
research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

## Funding

The author received no specific funding for this work.

## Data availability

All simulation code and the cached simulation results that every reported value
is computed from are available at <https://github.com/pgmj/rasch_fwer>. The
`phq9` dataset used to calibrate misfit severity is distributed with the
[`easyRasch2` R package](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/easyRasch2/index.html).

## Use of large language models

Large language models were used in preparing this work, as described in the
manuscript. The author takes responsibility for all content.
